Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Fixes market searches by using the normal name-search and exact-item selection flow, accepts fast listing responses, and adds same-world aetheryte transfers using the existing delivery route controller. Adds transfer debug tests and upgrades the Sapphire Avenue test route without changing its coordinates.

Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks submarine salvage accessories, item counts, and NPC sale values across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, and CSV export. Use /subinv to open.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
